title: Allowed Amount per Timed Unit for a Coming Insured Plan of Care Visit
content:
The allowed amount per unit used for a coming Insured Plan of Care visit is read from the plan's billed visits:

- from the latest billed visit carrying the timed units the coming visit is expected to carry, as its allowed amount divided by its units;
- where no billed visit carries those units, from the latest billed treatment visit;
- where no treatment visit has been billed either, from the latest billed visit.

The amount per unit is rounded half up to four decimal places.

## Questions and answers

**Which visit is "latest"?** The latest by date of service among the billed visits that meet the condition.

**The coming visit is expected at 3 units, and the plan's 3-unit visits were allowed at $126.00 (earlier) and $128.50 (later). What is the amount per unit?** $128.50 divided by 3, which is 42.8333 to four places.

**No billed visit has 3 units; the latest treatment visit had 4 units allowed at $170.00. What is the amount per unit?** $42.5000.

**No treatment visit has been billed; the only billed visit is an evaluation of 2 units allowed at $150.00. What is the amount per unit?** $75.0000.

**Hypothetical rounding check.** An allowed amount of $100.00 over 3 units is 33.33333…, which becomes 33.3333.
